name: Kojou Shio
source:
Likes: Taking Walks
Kazami Academy Second Year Class 2

Because her parents are on an overseas business trip she is living with her step-brother [url=/c5272]Takaaki[/url].
She's middling with her grades but surprisingly good at sports.
A member of the drama club.
